gloss: locking up; securing doors and windows

definitions.gloss: locking up; securing doors and windows
definitions.explanation: The act of locking doors and closing windows to secure a building before leaving or going to bed. An important daily routine in Japanese life.

examples.japanese: {戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the locks before going to bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧、⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}した→引き返す：05872_hikikaesu⟧。
examples.english: While I was out, I worried about whether I had locked up, so I turned back halfway.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as {戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to lock up). Also used as a noun in compounds and with ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (checking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to lock up)
- {戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check the locks)
- {戸締|とじ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to forget to lock up)

NOTE ON SPELLING:
Also written as {戸締|とじ}り without the ま. Both forms are used, but {戸締|とじ}まり is more common.
